REJECT
`ShipAsync` returns `ship.MainMoved` as `Requeued` even when `ship.Unjudged` is also set, whereas the original only set `requeued` in the `else if` branch, so a ship result carrying both would now requeue the merged packages (overwriting their "held" state), put `requeued` in the turn record, and add the "requeued: main moved" note, which changes behaviour.
